 Weekly Recalls: Acura, Chevrolet/GMC, Ford, Lincoln 
 Written By: CarPro

 Share:

 **ACURA** 
 LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST
 CRASH RISK 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V721000 
 Manufacturer Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) 
 Components STEERING 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 635808 
 Summary 
 Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Acura TLX, 2022-2024 Acura MDX, and 2023-2025 Pilot vehicles. The software for the electric power steering (EPS) assist may cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.
 Remedy 
 Dealers will reprogram the EPS control unit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. Honda's numbers for this recall are KQB and TQA. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 11, 2026.
 Click here for NHTSA Documents 
 **CHEVROLET/GMC** 
 IMPROPERLY TIGHTENED STEERING WHEEL GEAR ASSEMBLY NUT
 CRASH RISK 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V718000 
 Manufacturer General Motors, LLC 
 Components STEERING 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 12715 
 Summary 
 General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vehicles. The steering gear assembly may have a nut that was not properly tightened. 
 Remedy 
 Dealers will inspect the serial number and replace the steering gear assembly, if necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact GMC customer service at 1-888-988-7267 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020 . GM's number for this recall is N262579350. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 29, 2026. Vehicles that were not properly inspected under recall 26V399 will need to be re-inspected under 26V718. 
 Click here for NHTSA Documents 
 **FORD** 
 LOOSE 12-VOLT CABLE MAY CAUSE LOSS OF DRIVE POWER
 CRASH RISK 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V724000 
 Manufacturer Ford Motor Company 
 Components ELECTRICAL SYSTEM 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 8650 
 Summary 
 Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Maverick Hybrid vehicles. The 12V positive battery cable terminal may become loose or detach, which can cause a loss of electrical systems (including power steering assist, power brake assist, and exterior lighting) or a loss of drive power.
 Remedy 
 Dealers will replace the 12V battery cable, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 23, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S81. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 9, 2026.
 Click here for NHTSA Documents 
 **LINCOLN** 
 FRONT PASSENGER SEAT MAY MOVE UNEXPECTEDLY 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V691000 
 Manufacturer Ford Motor Company 
 Components SEATS 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 36994 
 Summary 
 Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Lincoln Navigator vehicles. The Rear Audio Control Module (RACM) may inadvertently command the chauffeur seat feature, causing the front passenger seat to adjust forward, rearward, or recline unexpectedly without occupant input. 
 Remedy 
 Dealers will update the accessory protocol interface module (APIM) and rear audio control module (RACM) software to disable chauffeur mode, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in November 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332 . Ford's number for this recall is 26S77. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 26, 2026.
